result.instructions: Tools for GitLab, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which merge requests are open in my main project and who reviews them?"; "Show the failed pipelines on the main branch from this week."; "List the open issues labelled bug, oldest first.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes GitLab data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run gitlab_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run gitlab_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run gitlab_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. gitlab_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: gitlab_whoami
tools.title: Show the signed-in user
tools.description: Return the GitLab user this token belongs to (id, username, name). Good first call to check the connection. GET /user.

tools.name: gitlab_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects visible to the token. Set membership to true to list only the projects you belong to. GET /projects.

membership.description: Only projects the user is a member of.

archived.description: Limit by archived status: true returns only archived projects. Omit for both.

tools.name: gitlab_get_project
tools.title: Get a project
tools.description: Return one project: path, default branch, visibility, topics and links. GET /projects/:id.

project.description: Project id (number) or full path, for example gitlab-org/gitlab.

tools.name: gitlab_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List groups visible to the token, optionally filtered by name. GET /groups.

tools.name: gitlab_list_issues
tools.title: List issues
tools.description: List issues in a project, filtered by state, labels, assignee or author. GET /projects/:id/issues.

project.description: Project id (number) or full path, for example gitlab-org/gitlab.

labels.description: Comma-separated label names; all must match.

assignee_username.description: Only issues assigned to this username.

author_username.description: Only issues created by this username.

tools.name: gitlab_get_issue
tools.title: Get an issue
tools.description: Return one issue by its project-scoped iid: title, description, state, labels and assignees. GET /projects/:id/issues/:iid.

project.description: Project id (number) or full path, for example gitlab-org/gitlab.

iid.description: Project-scoped number shown in the URL (for example 42 for !42 or #42).

tools.name: gitlab_list_issue_notes
tools.title: List issue comments
tools.description: List the comments (notes) on an issue, oldest first by default. GET /projects/:id/issues/:iid/notes.

project.description: Project id (number) or full path, for example gitlab-org/gitlab.

iid.description: Project-scoped number shown in the URL (for example 42 for !42 or #42).

tools.name: gitlab_list_merge_requests
tools.title: List merge requests
tools.description: List merge requests in a project, filtered by state, branches or author. GET /projects/:id/merge_requests.

project.description: Project id (number) or full path, for example gitlab-org/gitlab.

labels.description: Comma-separated label names; all must match.

tools.name: gitlab_get_merge_request
tools.title: Get a merge request
tools.description: Return one merge request by its project-scoped iid: title, state, branches, author, reviewers and merge status. GET /projects/:id/merge_requests/:iid.

project.description: Project id (number) or full path, for example gitlab-org/gitlab.

iid.description: Project-scoped number shown in the URL (for example 42 for !42 or #42).

tools.name: gitlab_list_pipelines
tools.title: List pipelines
tools.description: List CI/CD pipelines in a project, filtered by status or branch or tag. GET /projects/:id/pipelines.

project.description: Project id (number) or full path, for example gitlab-org/gitlab.

tools.name: gitlab_get_pipeline
tools.title: Get a pipeline
tools.description: Return one pipeline: status, ref, commit sha, duration and who triggered it. GET /projects/:id/pipelines/:pipeline_id.

project.description: Project id (number) or full path, for example gitlab-org/gitlab.

tools.name: gitlab_list_pipeline_jobs
tools.title: List pipeline jobs
tools.description: List the jobs of one pipeline with their stage, status and duration. GET /projects/:id/pipelines/:pipeline_id/jobs.

project.description: Project id (number) or full path, for example gitlab-org/gitlab.

tools.name: gitlab_list_branches
tools.title: List branches
tools.description: List branches of a repository, optionally filtered by name. GET /projects/:id/repository/branches.

project.description: Project id (number) or full path, for example gitlab-org/gitlab.

tools.name: gitlab_list_commits
tools.title: List commits
tools.description: List commits on a branch, tag or sha, optionally in a time window or touching one path. GET /projects/:id/repository/commits.

project.description: Project id (number) or full path, for example gitlab-org/gitlab.

ref_name.description: Branch, tag or sha (default: default branch).

path.description: Only commits that change this file or folder.

tools.name: gitlab_create_issue
tools.title: Create an issue
tools.description: Create a new issue in a project with a title, optional description and optional labels. POST /projects/:id/issues.

project.description: Project id (number) or full path, for example gitlab-org/gitlab.

tools.name: gitlab_create_issue_note
tools.title: Add an issue comment
tools.description: Add a comment (note) to an existing issue. POST /projects/:id/issues/:iid/notes.

project.description: Project id (number) or full path, for example gitlab-org/gitlab.

iid.description: Project-scoped number shown in the URL (for example 42 for !42 or #42).

prompts.name: getting_started

prompts.description: What you can do with GitLab here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: review_open_merge_requests

prompts.description: List the merge requests of a project, filtered by state. Read one by its iid to see its branches, reviewers and merge status.

prompts.name: find_failed_pipelines_on_a_branch
prompts.title: Find failed pipelines on a branch
prompts.description: List the pipelines of a project, filtered by status or branch. Read the jobs of one pipeline to see which stage failed.

prompts.name: triage_open_issues
prompts.title: Triage open issues
prompts.description: List the issues of a project, filtered by state or labels. Read one issue and its comments, oldest first by default.

prompts.name: open_an_issue_with_a_description_and_labels
prompts.title: Open an issue with a description and labels
prompts.description: Create a new issue in a project with a title, an optional description and optional labels.

prompts.name: add_a_status_comment_to_an_issue
prompts.title: Add a status comment to an issue
prompts.description: Add a comment to an existing issue, for example a status update.
